name: CDC ACIP Adult & Child Immunization Schedule 2026

rules.reason: Recommended during weeks 27–36 of each pregnancy to pass maternal antibodies to the infant, regardless of prior Tdap timing.
rules.evidence_citation: CDC ACIP Guideline Section 4.2: Administer 1 dose Tdap during each pregnancy, preferably during 27 through 36 weeks of gestation.
rules.review_reason: Confirm current gestational age with attending OB/GYN before administration.

rules.reason: Annual seasonal influenza vaccination recommended for all individuals ≥6 months of age, especially during pregnancy or healthcare employment.
rules.evidence_citation: CDC ACIP Guideline Section 1.1: Any licensed, age-appropriate inactivated influenza vaccine (IIV4) or recombinant influenza vaccine (RIV4) is indicated.

rules.reason: Healthcare workers are at high risk of bloodborne pathogen exposure. Complete 3-dose series or verify antibody titer.
rules.review_reason: Verify prior anti-HBs titer or unrecorded doses at other facilities.

rules.reason: Yellow fever risk exists for travel to endemic countries. Live virus vaccines require risk-benefit evaluation during pregnancy.
rules.evidence_citation: CDC Health Information for International Travel (Yellow Book 2026).
rules.review_reason: Live vaccine caution during pregnancy. Evaluate itinerary risk vs waiver certificate.
